title: P2 — Mesh protocol has no wire-format documentation and several claims are overstated: (a) docs/specs.md lists KeepaliveAck as a federation type but the type does not exist in code (docs drift); (b) README claims a REGISTER/REGISTER_ACK registration handshake — the server never sends REGISTER_ACK (no server-side REGISTER handler exists; client register() is fire-and-forget); (c) KEEPALIVE frames are sent by both sides every 30s but never processed server-side (no liveness effect); (d) response routing keys routes by request message_id but looks them up by response request_id — responders must echo the request's message_id as request_id or the response is silently dropped and the requester times out (hunter live-verified both directions with raw WS clients); (e) malformed frames (bad timestamp type, wrong target shape) are silently dropped with no ERROR frame and no log.
